meta.name: antinet-provenance
meta.description: 软件开发工程师与信息安全分析师在构建多智能体系统时，当需全链路可观测与安全审计，请用此技能。它自动收集操作日志，生成可追溯证据链与向量索引，开箱即用实现系统审计与精准回放，让Agent运行安全透明。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 收集Agent操作日志，构建可溯源证据链，实现安全审计与精准回放。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在构建多智能体系统，需要全链路可观测与安全审计。
copy.tagline_en: Collect agent operation logs as evidence chains for audit and replay.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building multi-agent systems and need full observability and audit trails.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会在分发、扫描、解析、卡片生成等关键操作节点记录事件，按 trace_id 串成证据链并生成向量索引；还能按 trace_id、时间窗等条件检索历史证据，支撑审计与回放。
howto.when: 当你要构建多智能体系统、需要全链路可观测与安全审计时；或各官署在关键操作节点调用、经事件总线异步推送事件时接管。

say.text: 帮我查出 trace_id 为 xxx 这条链路的完整证据链
say.note: 返回该 trace 串联的证据链

say.text: 把最近一小时各官署的操作事件按时间窗列出来
say.note: 按时间窗检索历史证据

say.text: 跑一下 scripts/run_provenance.py，生成留痕产物

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude records each dispatch, scan, parse and card-generation event, chains them into an evidence trail by trace_id and builds a vector index; you can query past evidence by trace_id, time window and so on for audit and replay.
howto.when_en: Used when building multi-agent systems that need end-to-end observability and security audit, or when officers call it at key operation points or push events through the event bus.

say_en.text: Show me the full evidence chain for trace_id xxx
say_en.note: Returns the trail chained by that trace

say_en.text: List all officer events from the last hour by time window
Run scripts/run_provenance.py to produce the provenance artifacts
